description: Corrections to the identity of sheet-derived venues: the name, trust, position or storey that data/mapped-sites.json got wrong. The drafter (scripts/nhs/draft-sheets.mjs) names a sheet after the ODS record it matched, and ODS files departments, closed sites and legacy trusts as sites — so a John Radcliffe map arrived under the Nuffield Orthopaedic Centre trust, a St George's map on Woking, and Southport's on the closed town-centre infirmary. scripts/maps/sheets.mjs lays these entries over the drafted ones every time the sheets are read, so a --force re-draft cannot undo a correction a person has checked; scripts/maps/apply-identity.mjs writes the same corrections into the committed venue modules and into mapped-sites.json, which is how they reach the app without the source PDFs.
howToAdd: Only record what you have checked against the trust's own website, the NHS ODS register or the sheet's own title, and say which in `evidence`, dated in `checked`. `center` is [lat, lng]. `spanM` is the full sheet width in metres and is only needed when the drafted scale came from the wrong hospital's footprint — it is an estimate until someone checks the drawing against the map. `floor` re-storeys a single-sheet venue whose sheet is one level of a building; `floorNaming` goes with it when the trust numbers its levels from something other than the ground.

st-marys-paddington.notes: Step-free routes shown on the trust's site map; nearest step-free stations at Paddington. The site is changing: the main outpatients building was due to close by March 2026, structural problems were found in the Mint building in late 2025, and a new hospital is planned on the east of the estate — check where a service now sits before routing to it. The trust's February 2024 site map is the current edition.
st-marys-paddington.evidence: imperial.nhs.uk St Mary's find-us page (outpatients building closure by 31 March 2026), the trust's February 2025 statement on the Mint building, and its July 2026 news on the emerging designs; smh-map.pdf is dated February 2024.

whipps-cross-hospital.notes: Zones 1–12 across the ground and first floors of the main building, with further wards in the Gateway Surgical Centre. A new 500-space multi-storey car park opened in November 2025, entered from Hospital Road by the main entrance; the site will be under construction for the hospital's rebuild from 2027.
whipps-cross-hospital.evidence: bartshealth.nhs.uk news on the multi-storey car park (opened 3 November 2025) and the redevelopment update; the hospital page's description of the zones.

gosh.evidence: Checked September 2026: the Great Ormond Street entrance is closed for the Children's Cancer Centre build (the Frontage Building was taken down by July 2025) and the main entrance is the Morgan Stanley Clinical Building on Guilford Street — which is where this venue already places Main Entrance.
